name: repository-health-assessment
description: Read-only repository health assessment: weighted coverage, lane maturity scorecards, an anchored A-F grade with caps and confidence, a validated generic Evidence Recon sidecar, and a candidate ledger routed to the architecture and integrity skills.

depends_on.provides: canonical candidate contract, the eight 1-5 scores, priority_score, dedup rules, and lifecycle schema
executable verification and rendering of the candidate half of the shared spine
depends_on.failure_mode: verifyHealth reports ledger-module-missing; the report renders a red candidate panel and does not ship

depends_on.provides: canonical generic evidence packet, coverage/evidence/epistemic vocabulary, negative-claim receipts, and contradiction state
packet validation, inline/expedition mode guidance, and deterministic expedition-lane merge
depends_on.failure_mode: the generic evidence sidecar does not validate or ship; health grading remains owned by the health island and is never hand-repaired

depends_on.provides: aggressive assessment scheduling, cache, and performance receipts
generic bounded executor semantics for read-only worker scheduling
shared ask/generate/skip/inherit report-presentation contract and machine-lean validation

known_risk: This package validates health provenance, projects a conservative generic Evidence Recon sidecar, and delegates candidate scoring, dependency, eligibility, ranking, lifecycle, and rendering to the canonical shared spine. Missing or incompatible required modules are hard failures. The sidecar never owns or alters the health grade.

dev_dependencies.ajv: ^8 — used only by assets/parity-check.js, never by the generated report
dev_dependencies.ledger-verify.js: required for parity-check.js and package-check.js; resolved from shared/candidate-ledger-spine or LEDGER_VERIFY_PATH
dev_dependencies.evidence-recon.js: required for package-check.js and evidence-recon-projection.js; resolved from shared/evidence-recon, EVIDENCE_RECON_PATH, or an explicit path

performance.surface_inventory: parallel deterministic construction; frozen before final grading

presentation.canonical_machine_artifact: validated health island + candidate ledger + Evidence Recon sidecar
